title: AI Agents Got Root on Linux via 948 Kernel Flaws in OpenAI Research
description: OpenAI research using an unreleased AI model discovered and exploited 948 distinct Linux kernel privilege escalation vulnerabilities in the kernel's master branch, generating working exploits and patches. The research demonstrated that unpatched Linux systems with low-privileged user access can be escalated to root by well-resourced attackers. OpenAI has submitted hundreds of patches and is working with the community to remediate these flaws. The company warns that outdated Linux systems should be considered effectively compromised if accessed by low-privileged users. Mitigations include applying patches promptly and using sandboxing and isolation technologies.
